evidence: We recognize that the sophistication of cyber-threats will continue to evolve as threat actors increase their use of artificial intelligence technologies.
We implement layered systems safeguards to enable the protection of our information systems from cybersecurity threats.
We actively manage cybersecurity risks posed by third parties and their systems that could impact our operations.
ai_positioning.summary: GBX adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, reconnaissant l'évolution des menaces cybernétiques liées aux technologies d'IA utilisées par les acteurs malveillants, sans développer ou intégrer l'IA dans ses propres solutions.
